_note: Floor 2 of the Drambus Stack, and one sitting. `outside` is what makes it one: beating the boss puts you back in the field and a save taken inside reopens there too, so a floor is a thing you go in and finish or do not. Ten by ten, one thing at the end of it, and the next entry is a different map because the tower is a floor shorter. Which floor the door opens onto is derived from what has been answered rather than from a counter — the boss tiles are the record, and the order they come down in is the whole of the condition.

places.name: what is standing on floor 2
prose: Forty feet of it comes down in one piece and lands on the crumb field, which is what the crumb field is for.
The woman with the net is still standing in it. She has not caught a fly and she has now been standing there for fourteen days. One floor left.
